ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across approximately 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to scar tissue and distal tip encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black/dark grey) contiguous area across the majority of both lobes; high-contrast white clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips and scattered linear white pixel strings across the central and outer lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edges exhibit low-amplitude wave-like irregularities; distal tips exhibit high-frequency, high-amplitude jaggedness and protrusion clusters due to biological accretion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep from the central notch towards the distal tips, terminating in sharp upwardly-angled points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, dense clusters of roughly circular white high-contrast pixels (barnacle colonies) located at the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes; several isolated white circular spots present in the mid-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel segments; notably a group of three parallel diagonal marks on the upper right lobe and several scattered horizontal segments on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips causing significant morphological irregularity of the fluke boundary; multiple distinct white rake marks/linear scars across both ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Metadata overlay present in the lower quadrant including alphanumeric identifiers: TEC01-20/25, ID 10661, TODD CHANDLER, 05 Aug 01 Half Moon Bay.
